part: D — absent-vs-broken discrimination, at every hop
description: Collapsing 'nothing in this deployment joins these two facts' into 'the join is recorded and does not hold' is the central risk of the whole model: the two have different readers, different remedies and different urgency, and a chain that folded them would be readable as a clean bill by a deployment that had simply composed nothing. One dedicated pair per hop, so the discrimination is pinned everywhere rather than at whichever hop happened to be probed.
